headline: Gutter's The Parras Changes Hands; Other Fronts Hold
war_summary: Since the last edition, the only fresh shift on the strategic-base wire comes in Gutter, where The Parras has changed hands to the Colonials; the map now counts six Warden posts against one Colonial. Every other region that swapped flags in the earlier reports has held its line: Linn Mercy remains ten Colonial to one Warden, Fishermans Row eight Colonial to one Warden, Stonecradle six Colonial to three Warden, Weathered Expanse six Warden to three Colonial, and Stlican Shelf still stands five Warden posts to four Colonial. None has recorded a strategic-base event in the latest two-hour span. The casualty returns remain high on Marban Hollow, Nevish Line, DeadLands, and Farranac Coast, with no ownership change logged there, and Callahan's Passage stays wholly Warden amid heavy attrition. No faction has yet met the thirty-four-town requirement.
